caption:
OpenAI has released the System Card for Operator, its autonomous web browsing agent. As AI evolves from answering prompts to taking actions on real websites, security risks fundamentally change. Prompt injection is no longer just about offensive text—it can become an unauthorized command execution. OpenAI details a multi-layered defensive strategy combining model mitigations, product boundaries, and external red teaming. Swipe through for the breakdown of how agent safety is changing forever.

Source: OpenAI System Card (https://openai.com/index/operator-system-card)
